Bn.bar_b_note: A credible naturalistic wolf model, but the near-black brown fur with dull ember cracks sinks into the dark stage, so at 30% it reads as a dark lump without the rim-lit, high-contrast pop of a Palworld creature.

Wn.bar_b_note: The violet-and-white storm wolf matches the Tanglevolt quality bar and reads instantly; only the legs-up faint roll with a shadow blob sitting below the body holds it back.

Nq.bar_b_note: A saturated cyan water drake with fin crests reads clearly at a glance as a Palworld-class creature, but A's faint end collapses into a knotted vertical tangle and B's faint frames wash pale and lift off their shadow.

Hb.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, cross-brace, plank cap and stone footing read as a built thing, but it is still one isolated upright panel in a flat midday grade with no fog depth or light shafts, and B is a blank white card.

Jh.bar_b_note: The fleece-and-horn ram matches the Stormcapra bar and reads instantly; A's faint turns into a featureless fleece pillow with horns and B's tumbling faint frames look less grounded.

Dj.bar_b_note: A clean, grounded naturalistic coyote with good faint poses, but it has no creature-fantasy identity (no storm, element or signature feature) beside the Palworld roster or the owner's style bar.

Sj.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder villager with clear eyes, a moss-green vest and an earthy palette that fits the key art settlement, finished like a Palworld NPC.

Xh.bar_b_note: The same plain coyote as Dj: well grounded and well modelled, but generic wildlife rather than a Tetherbound creature with its own identity.

Bd.bar_b_note: The grey storm wolf's faint blue streaks are too small and dim to carry identity, and the slate body merges with the slate stage, so it reads as a weaker, desaturated Tanglevolt.

top_changes.change: Push creature value separation and signature colour: brighten and saturate the storm/ember markings and add a rim term on Bn, Bd (and the dark-on-dark wolves generally) so they read at 30% against the ground, as Wn already does.

Give the plain coyote (Dj/Xh) and the grey wolf (Bd) a signature creature-fantasy feature (elemental markings, crest, horn or plating) so each roster member has its own identity at the owner-bar level.

Fix the faint poses that break the read: Nq A's knotted collapse, the pale wash and lift in Nq B's faint frames, Jh A's legless fleece pillow and Wn's legs-up roll with a detached shadow; keep fainted bodies resting on their shadows.
